name: Xhem
text: Ticket 2604: the washroom hand dryer on floor two keeps cutting out after five seconds. The fuse was swapped but the cutoff still trips. Part on order, Xhem.

name: Muscas
text: Ticket 2617: the stairwell lights on the west side flicker whenever the lift runs. The ballast was swapped last month and the fault came back within days. An electrician is booked for Tuesday, parts listed by Muscas.

name: Jan-Ulrich Gurb
text: Ticket 2629: the kitchen extraction drops to half speed at the evening peak and the smell backs up into the dining room. The belt was tensioned and the filters were cleaned, but the amps still climb. A contractor has quoted for a new motor and the quote sits with the landlord, action logged by Jan-Ulrich Gurb.

name: Venny Sheren Karkanawi
text: Ticket 2633: the visitor printer jams on every third badge and the queue reaches the lobby. Temp pass issued at the desk, sorted by Venny Sheren Karkanawi.

name: Edvaldo
text: Ticket 2648: the sink in the second floor kitchen drains slowly and backs up when the tap runs. The trap was cleared once already this month. A jetting visit is due Friday, chased by Edvaldo.

name: Cognié
text: Ticket 2654: the loading shutter remote only works within ten feet of the post, so drivers are stepping into the lane to open it. New batteries did not help and the receiver may be failing. A replacement kit is on order with a two week lead time, raised by Cognié.

name: Taís Djevahire Agbedonou
text: Ticket 2661: the coffee machine grinder squeals and the decaf hopper jams. Loan grinder in place, parts ordered by Taís Djevahire Agbedonou.

name: Naci Höllinger
text: Ticket 2672: the north fire door alarm chirps every few minutes after the panel was serviced. The battery reads fine and the sensor was cleaned. The panel engineer will return Thursday with the diagnostics kit, booked by Naci Höllinger.

name: Laurentiu-Constantin
text: Ticket 2680: the room booking panel outside meeting room 3 shows the wrong slots all week and double books anything after lunch. The calendar sync was restarted twice and the cache was cleared. The interim book stays on the desk until then. A firmware update is staged for the weekend, scheduled by Laurentiu-Constantin.

name: Mönkhoff
text: Ticket 2688: mouse seen behind the vending machine on floor one twice this week. Traps set and the gap sealed, monitored by Mönkhoff.

name: Amy Smith
text: Ticket 2694: the accessible lift button on the ground floor needs a firm press and visitors keep walking away thinking it is broken. The pad was cleaned and the contact tested twice. A replacement pad is ordered for next week, updated by Amy Smith.

name: Metin Sabba
text: Ticket 2701: the parcel cage light has been out since the fitting above the door failed, and the couriers are signing by torchlight at the evening drop. The circuit was tested and the ballast is the culprit. A replacement ballast is in stock and the swap is booked for Friday morning, handed over by Metin Sabba.

name: Keilan
text:
Hi all,

The server room door code changes Friday, so pick up the new fob from the office before then. The old code stops working at six sharp.

Thanks,
Keilan

name: Brown
text:
Hi,

The compost deliveries move to Thursday mornings from next week, so the bins will be out on the kerb by seven. Please keep the path clear for the truck and do not add extra bags after the lids are shut.

Regards,
Brown

name: Rizwana Nabeela
text:
Hello,

The audit pack for the water treatment contract is now on the shared drive under compliance, and the printed copy sits in the compliance folder. Please send corrections to the office by Wednesday afternoon so the version can be locked. A short briefing runs Thursday at nine in the small rooms.

Best regards,
Rizwana Nabeela

name: Tsgeweini Ardouin Greensmith
text:
Hi team,

The drying rack in the kiln room was re glued and the loose pin was replaced. No stacking greenware on it until Friday.

Thanks,
Tsgeweini Ardouin Greensmith

name: Majk
text:
Morning,

The gate camera view was adjusted yesterday so the lane and the barrier are both in frame now. Parking permits must sit on the dash on the left side to be read. Visitors sign in at the booth as before.

Cheers,
Majk

name: Lomuto
text:
Hello,

The pontoon inspection report came back clean apart from two bolts that need swapping on the south ramp. The diving club has the torque wrench and is lending it to us on Saturday. Please keep the ramp closed until the new bolts are fitted and signed off.

Regards,
Lomuto

name: Wafic Sarasola
text:
Hi all,

The tuck shop till float grows to fifty on Fridays, so bring coins from the safe in the morning. Cards still work as usual.

Thanks,
Wafic Sarasola

name: San José
text:
Morning,

The marquee guy ropes were re tensioned after the wind and the pegs were checked. The side panels stay off until Friday so the grass can dry. If the forecast turns, put the panels up and weight the legs.

Regards,
San José

name: Cabdalla
text:
Hello,

The tree planting day has moved to the second Saturday because the saplings arrive late from the nursery. Volunteers should bring gloves and a spade if they have one. Lunch is soup and bread in the hall, and the minibus leaves the square at half eight. The roster is on the noticeboard with two slots open.

Cheers,
Cabdalla

name: Gharb
text:
Hi,

The umbrella stand parts arrived and the broken spoke was swapped on the blue one. The green one leans, so keep it out of the front window.

Thanks,
Gharb

name: El Hanzouli
text:
Morning,

The library returns crate goes back on Tuesday now, so scan anything you want to send by Monday close of play. Fines letters went out yesterday to the usual stragglers. New cards print at the desk as before.

Regards,
El Hanzouli

name: Arvanitakis Berquier Rauso
text:
Hello,

The rain gauge and the wind logger were swapped onto the new post by the field gate, and both are reporting to the dashboard again. The old post was pulled out and the hole was filled. Please log any gaps in the feed so the calibration team can account for them.

Best regards,
Arvanitakis Berquier Rauso

name: Billy
text:
my parcel was left on the step in the rain n the box was soaked through, the tracking says it was handed to me which isnt true, thanks,
Billy

name: Bositampen
text:
the gym kept charging me after i cancelled in march n the front desk says the direct debit is still live, i have the cancellation email with the date on it, please stop the payments n refund the last three months, thanks,
Bositampen

name: Weiping Jazmín
text:
the broadband has dropped out every evening for a fortnight n the router shows a red light until i power cycle it, the provider ran a line test n says the signal to the flat is fine so the fault must be inside, please send an engineer with a replacement router, thanks,
Weiping Jazmín

name: Trubic Cleuet
text:
the car wash scratched the bonnet n the manager says it must have been like that, i have photos from this morning showing it wasnt, regards,
Trubic Cleuet

name: Ilkan
text:
the hotel charged a minibar fee for a room we never used n reception said the system logs it automatically, i asked for the itemised bill twice n its not been sent, the charge is still on my card, please remove it, thanks,
Ilkan

name: Hasselbeck
text:
the delivery slot was booked for saturday between nine and twelve n nobody came, i waited in all morning n the tracking was updated to say i was out which is rubbish, i rang support n was told to rebook myself for a slot that costs extra, please rebook it for free or refund the delivery fee, thanks,
Hasselbeck

name: Evgeniya Benvenuta
text:
the nail bar chipped two of my nails within a day of the appointment n they refuse a redo without another booking fee, please help, thanks,
Evgeniya Benvenuta

name: Crop Forney
text:
the dry cleaner lost the belt to my coat n only found it after three visits, the coat came back with the lining torn as well n they deny touching it, i want the repair paid for, thanks,
Crop Forney

name: Leonita
text:
the council tax portal wont let me set up a direct debit n the error says my account is already registered, i never set one up for this property n the helpline number rings out every time, ive been trying for two weeks n the first payment date is coming up, please sort it b4 the deadline, thanks,
Leonita

name: Özen
text:
the vending machine took my money twice n gave nothing either time, the refund sticker number goes to voicemail, please refund me, thanks,
Özen

name: Yayesh Lumduan
text:
the bike I ordered came with the wrong size frame n the returns label they sent is for a different order, the shop asked for photos which i sent last week n theres been no reply since, please arrange a collection, thanks,
Yayesh Lumduan

name: Skyla Maria-Iuliana
text:
the clinic rescheduled my scan twice at short notice n the second time i was already in the waiting room, they say the machine broke down but nobody told me b4 i left home, i took a morning off work for nothing, ive asked for a written apology n a guaranteed slot, please escalate this, thanks,
Skyla Maria-Iuliana

name: Aslam
text:
the parcel shop refused my return cos the label was printed at home, they only take app labels, the app wont load on my phone, thanks,
Aslam

name: Laté
text:
Hi,

The fire drill runs Wednesday at eleven and takes about twenty minutes. Wardens should collect their vests from the office in the morning and check the stairwells as usual. Report any blocked exits before then.

Thanks,
Laté

name: N'guessan
text:
Hello,

The spring water test results came back clean for every tap sampled, including the one by the staff room that used to run warm. The certificate is pinned in the kitchen and a copy goes to the letting agent. Please keep the sample log topped up with the date each time the taps are flushed.

Best regards,
N'guessan

name: Zekri Williams
text:
Hi all,

The noticeboard cork was replaced and the old pins are in the tin on the shelf. Please use the new pins.

Thanks,
Zekri Williams

name: Marchesan Ryzo
text:
Morning,

The floor buffer pads arrived and the spares fit the older machine too. Cleaning runs before opening on Thursday instead of Friday this week because of the viewing. Keys are with the caretaker as usual.

Regards,
Marchesan Ryzo

name: Nazek
text:
Hello,

The booking sheet for the tennis courts has been moved to the online form, and the clipboard comes down on Friday. Anyone with standing slots should re enter them this week so the season runs smoothly. The club will honour the old times where they clash. Contact the office if the form gives you trouble.

Cheers,
Nazek

name: Bisogni
text:
Hi,

The hand towel order came in twice, so the spare boxes are in the store room. Help yourself from there this month.

Thanks,
Bisogni

name: Hortense Margreta
text:
Morning,

The village hall chairs were stacked back against the west wall after the fete, and the stage steps are in the cupboard. Two chairs need new feet and sit in the porch. The caretaker will glue them on Tuesday.

Regards,
Hortense Margreta

name: Janek Vakuyeva
text:
Hello,

The archive boxes for the old contracts were re labelled by year and moved to the top shelf so the floor stays clear. The shelving plan is taped inside the door for anyone hunting a folder. Please sign the sheet when you take a box out. Digital scans are on the shared drive as usual.

Thanks,
Janek Vakuyeva

name: Senad
text:
Hi,

The shoe rack by the door was fixed and the loose hook was replaced. Please keep bags off it so it stays standing.

Thanks,
Senad

name: Dunkley
text:
Morning,

The recycling points moved to the corner by the loading bay so vans have a clear run. Blue bins take card and paper only, and the glass goes in the crate. The spot is coned off while the paint dries.

Regards,
Dunkley

name: Puchas Tyssen
text:
Hello,

The coach for the away match leaves the sports hall at noon sharp and returns about seven. Seats are two pounds for players and free for the year nines helping with kit. Bring water and a light jacket because the forecast turns later. The team sheet goes up Friday.

Cheers,
Puchas Tyssen

name: Willitsch Rahova Lasing
text:
Hi all,

The studio door code was changed after the lockout, and the new one is on the usual card by the kettle.

Thanks,
Willitsch Rahova Lasing

name: Reißig
text:
Morning,

The mower blade was sharpened and the oil was changed, so the small mower is back in the shed. The strimmer still needs a new spool and is on the list for the shop run.

Regards,
Reißig
